item.title: Africa's Deadliest Rivalries — Lion, Hippo, Crocodile & Honey Badger
item.description:
Africa's Deadliest Rivalries — Lion, Hippo, Crocodile & Honey Badger - Join us live as we break down Africa's most brutal animal rivalries in real time — lion vs hyena, leopard vs lion, hippo vs crocodile, and honey badger vs venomous snakes. We're watching the footage together, breaking down the science behind who actually wins each matchup, and taking your questions live in chat.
Drop your vote in chat for which rivalry you want covered next, and stick around for the final "Africa's Apex Ranking" poll at the end of the stream.
Subscribe and hit the bell for more Apex Files breakdowns every week.
